summary: The StudentRAITProvisioning system manages student provisioning related to RAIT and involves various functionalities such as searching, adding, updating, and deleting student provisioning entries.
purpose: To manage student provisioning in the RAIT system, enabling operations like search, add, update, and delete through database procedures.

workflows.name: Student Provisioning Add
steps: Add parameters: SessionID, StudentID, AgencyID, UniqueID, LoginID, EmailRequired, Employee, Email, StaffID

workflows.name: Student Provisioning Update
steps: Add parameters: SessionID, ID, AgencyID, UniqueID, LoginID, EmailRequired, Employee, Email

workflows.name: Batch Update
steps: Serialize student provisioning list to XML

business_rules: Cannot run queries if ID or CohortID is less than or equal to 0.
validations: Ensure ID and CohortID are greater than 0 before executing search queries.
system_behavior: Retrieves student provisioning information based on parameters provided.
Adds new student provisioning entries to the database.
Updates existing student provisioning entries based on ID.
Deletes student provisioning entries based on ID.
Processes batch updates using XML serialization.
exceptions: No data will be processed if ID or CohortID is invalid.
